technical.summary: Early oversold bounce signals (stoch cross, Williams %R rising) lack conviction due to pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, MACD negative, weak ADX), making this a low-probability swing entry despite technical relief.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 60 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Weak bearish congressional signal from junior Democratic members selling small positions 105+ days ago; broad market neutral sentiment with no news data to confirm directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (196.0) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational industrials, and earnings in 60 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Stochastic bullish cross and Williams %R rising from oversold extremes suggest early bounce potential with support at 81.366 nearby for risk containment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, MACD negative, RSI sub-50, weak ADX trend), macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 196, strong dollar), zero fundamental conviction, and 60-day earnings event risk overwhelm technical relief signals.
